title: Cloud Cargo
controls: Left / Right chooses a crate or bay
Space selects crate or assigns it to a bay
mobile_controls: Tap an airship bay to assign it

implementation_contract.goal: LOAD 3 AIRSHIPS in 50 seconds. This is Cloud Cargo: a stationary cargo allocation puzzle. Tap a crate, then an airship bay to assign it. Each bay requires an exact MASS total and, in later manifests, an exact ENERGY total. All crates must be allocated and all targets met to dispatch one manifest. Three manifests complete the expedition. Put the exact visible short objective LOAD 3 AIRSHIPS above the board before Start, not buried in prose. Show actual launched count 0/3 to 3/3 in [data-cargo-goal-progress].
implementation_contract.mechanic: Dual-resource cargo assignment, NOT spatial optical routing, column merging, reaction or timing. Cargo cards carry small positive integer mass (1..5) and energy (0..3); never merge cards. Assign each card to one bay, with reassignment always possible. Stage 0: four cards, two bays, only mass targets active. Stage 1: five cards, three bays, mass AND energy active. Stage 2: six cards, three bays, both active with deliberate ambiguous mass-only fits requiring cross-bay energy planning. Construct each seed board from a valid hidden allocation, derive exact bay targets, then shuffle cards/targets. Every bay gets at least one card. Never expose the hidden allocation or auto-solve. Use multiple generated value sets, not three fixed templates or seed-specific special cases. No randomly generated impossible target. Reject wrong/partial load by keeping board editable, visibly mark mismatches, and dispatch only exact full solutions automatically after a short 24..45 tick validation hold. At dispatch award actual points and show each airship lift off. Show only the current manifest, do not grow board size beyond six cards/three bays.
implementation_contract.progression: Three manifests with 4/5/6 required cargo allocations. State.stage is launched manifests, starts 0, advances to 1,2,3; state.cards and state.bays describe current board. Keep each solved dispatch visible briefly before replacing board. Score per correctly dispatched manifest with a small time/efficiency bonus; no passive free score. Count real selection/assignment/dispatch interactions. Session runs at 60 fixed ticks/second; normal fail at tick 3000 (50 seconds). If all three dispatch early, wait until tick 900 (15 seconds) before core.terminal, showing a celebratory finished expedition meanwhile. Success 3/3 vs incomplete must be explicit. Normal input solve must work at every seed; restart same seed for mastery; fresh normal visit uses GameKit random seed. Generic observe.progress may be elapsed integer percent for liveness, but label that UI ELAPSED % and keep objective progress separate; never confuse elapsed progress with the completion goal.
implementation_contract.presentation: Original procedural skyport art, deep ink/navy background, warm parchment cargo panels, coral/orange selection, cyan airship envelopes and a bright small mint success accent. Design a composed polished playable scene, not a debug panel. Three compact airship silhouettes serve as visible expedition progress. Large readable numeric targets and cargo badges, distinct shapes/icons plus text so color is not the only information. Show selected card and target highlight, assigned bay letter on each card, live bay totals against targets, brief bounded connection/dispatch feedback. Clear dominant Start / Replay. Put CURRENT SCORE [data-game-score] and DEVICE BEST [data-cargo-best] separately in DOM with LOCAL PRACTICE label; read best exclusively from the real GameKit snapshot.best every frame. No separate storage. Use an app draw wrapper to update auxiliary DOM while passing a cloned snapshot to drawing-only view. Optional sound is intentionally omitted for this candidate: no AudioContext, audio or sound toggle; prioritize visual feedback.
implementation_contract.originality: Compared with all eight public families and rejected Prism Relay: no arena avatar or autofire, no tower rotation, no radial pins, no merging columns, no running, no reaction/timing-window scoring, no light beams/prisms/routes. Actual player decision is partitioning a shared finite cargo set among simultaneously constrained bays. Generic allocation-puzzle ideas are not claimed as an invented genre. This skyport presentation, bounded three-manifest progression and procedural cargo are original code/art for this candidate. Astra Sentinel V3 / Deep Descent are lifecycle/clarity/feedback quality baselines only. Do not inspect/copy their code, brand, characters or art. No copyrighted borrowed assets or code, external assets, runtime dependencies, CDN, analytics, network service or account requirement.
implementation_contract.difficulty: At least six deterministic seeds (1,7,23,89,2026,4294967295) will be independently solved through normal keyboard or CDP touch. Required minimum assignments must increase 4->5->6; late stage activates two simultaneous dimensions and three shared bays. At stage 2 ensure at least one mass-valid full allocation fails energy while another meets both: this demonstrates a real extra constraint rather than only more clicks. Generate varying values/target combinations across seeds, bounded construction retries with a deterministic valid fallback covering all seeds, not QA-only special cases. Expose card/bay values in canonical snapshots so an independent exhaustive allocation oracle can calculate solution counts and execute a valid solution. Do not include a solve cheat or QA autowin. A valid second-stage solution must not consume all session time due mandatory waits.
implementation_contract.mobile_readability: 390px is the primary layout. All meaningful DOM labels >=12 CSS px and canvas text >=12 CSS px at 390. Keep objective, Start, score/best and board legible with clear spacing. Never draw a subtitle through score/targets. Use responsive board width <=650px, portrait aspect ratio around 0.85, no clipping or fixed-height panels. Board text must fit individual panels with safe padding; numeric mass/energy rows have separate y coordinates. Put longer instructions in short DOM text outside canvas. Canvas contains only short bay/card labels and values, no duplicated giant DOM title. Fixed normalized hit layout: bay centers x=(i+.5)/bays.length, y=.25, bay region y=.08..39; six possible cargo slots centers x=(i%3+.5)/3, y=.55+floor(i/3)*.25, cargo region y=.43..92. Crates laid out in this stable 3-column x 2-row grid with 4/5/6 real cards. This keeps generic touch (.72,.55) inside card index2. Touch card selects it; touch bay assigns selected card. Always show the visible rectangle matching the touch hit zones. No two text labels may materially overlap, including inside canvas. Blank unoccupied slots are not selectable.
implementation_contract.result: At final success show SKYPORT COMPLETE, 3/3 dispatched airships, current score, actual device best, concise score breakdown (completed manifests and assignments), a strong original fleet departure vignette and a prominent Play Again button [data-game-restart]. Incomplete timeout shows CARGO INCOMPLETE and x/3 with same score/best/replay structure and one short useful retry hint. Use [data-cargo-result] for result heading (hidden during play), and [data-cargo-result-detail] for completion breakdown. Retain goal/current/best at terminal, do not cover key information with canvas text. Retry starts playable and keeps best. Capture/QA uses GameKit in-memory best without any record write; ordinary practice uses only GameKit record key.
implementation_contract.reduced_motion: Listen to matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') changes while running, not only at load. Set data-reduced-motion=true/false on [data-cargo-shell], pass current reducedMotion through the app drawing wrapper into view.draw, and suppress nonessential drifting, flight movement, pulses/particles and CSS animations while reduced. Static highlights and clear state changes remain. Changes in both directions must take effect without reload. Expose a read-only CargoPresentation.snapshot() returning {reducedMotion:boolean,particles:number,activeVoices:0} for audit, without replacing GameDiagnostics or putting preference in canonical core. Pause/pagehide must not leak effects/listeners. No private RAF loop; GameKit owns runtime. Resource cap at most 60 decorative particles, entity count truthful <=128.
implementation_contract.runtime_details: GameKit API EXACTLY: core.create(seed), core.step(state,input) (NO dt argument, each tick 1/60s), core.observe(state)->{tick,score,progress,interactions,entities}, core.terminal(state)->boolean; expose one named global object. State plain JSON, no DOM/time/random globals in core. state.tick increments every step. state.focus starts0 and is an index into current cards THEN bays. ArrowLeft/Right (or x input) moves focus, edge-triggered or debounced, so ArrowRight for200ms must change focus. Space activates focused card/bay. Pointerdown sets action AND normalized pointer simultaneously: handle once, not both pointer and keyboard. state.selectedCard starts0; touching (.72,.55) selects actual card2, changing selectedCard and highlight. state.cards array of {mass,energy,bay}, bay=-1 initially, integer0..bays.length-1 after allocation. state.bays array of {mass,energy}, energy=null in stage0 (ignored), integer>=0 stage1/2. Preserve these observable field names. state.stage counts dispatched manifests; state.assignments counts actual bay changes across stages. state.score finite. Expose visible card/bay values, never hidden solution. At final stage3 retain last solved board for result illustration. Generated view accepts (ctx,snapshot,{width,height,reducedMotion}); canonical state is snapshot.state. app fetches ./manifest.json and passes metadata to PlayJoltGameKit.create({core,draw,canvas,metadata}); create returns diagnostics not snapshot directly, use kit.diagnostics.snapshot or draw snapshot. Built-in kit writes status,score,progress and lifecycle button visibility each frame: use separate cargo DOM hooks, do not overwrite those. Do not call missing helper/API. No eval/import/scripts/tool calls. Full six required files only; manifest/gamekit supplied by Factory.
